payload.title: Remote login can fail with nonce_mismatch after a correct approval
payload.description: 2026-11-03, Machines on Machines, papyrus 5.72 with cli-login 0.4.0: the first papyrus login --remote was approved and ended with: The sign-in answered tokens for a different request; nothing was saved. A second attempt minutes later succeeded with the same steps. Cause unknown. /cli/challenge answers 404 on this site, so enrollment looks off and the pages should use the CLI's own nonce. The first attempt recorded no diagnostics. A process started shortly before it had been killed before its link was ever shown, so it had no approval. Reproduce and find out why the ID token's nonce differed; the error should also tell the person to start again.
